name: onlymonkes
_securityOverridesNote: Overrides below address Dependabot/npm-audit findings from SECURITY_AUDIT_2026-05-02.md plus a 2026-09-12 refresh (67 GitHub Dependabot alerts triaged). protobufjs/undici/xmldom floors bumped — the 2026-05 floors were satisfied by versions Dependabot has since flagged as newly vulnerable again. bigint-buffer is already at its ceiling (1.1.5 is the latest published version and is itself listed vulnerable — no upstream fix exists; accepted risk, see SECURITY_AUDIT_2026-05-02.md MED-2 for the bounded-exploitability reasoning). Deliberately NOT touching: Express (only a major-version-5 fix exists — Express 4 vs 5 has real breaking API changes, and this is transitive dev-tooling, not app runtime, so not worth that risk), brace-expansion (chaotic multi-major-line situation across many nested Expo/babel/detox copies — a single override can't cleanly resolve all of them, and it's a ReDoS in a glob-matcher only ever invoked during local builds/tests, zero runtime exposure), and the entire Expo-core cluster (expo-dev-client, jest-expo, @expo/config, @expo/prebuild-config, expo-updates, expo-splash-screen) — every fix there is a semver-major Expo SDK bump (53->57+), none of it ships in the compiled app or runs on a user's device (build-time/dev-only tooling), and per this project's own policy any native-SDK-touching change belongs in a dedicated worktree with full regression testing, not a quick dependency patch. Sit dormant in this file until the next `npm install` + APK build cycle (intentional — keeps the current OTA bundle / lockfile unchanged).

scripts.eas-build-pre-install: if [ -n "$GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON" ] && [ -f "$GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON" ]; then cp "$GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON" android/app/google-services.json && echo "[eas-build-pre-install] google-services.json restored from secret"; else echo "[eas-build-pre-install] no GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON env var or file missing (local build)"; fi; rm -f bun.lock && echo "[eas-build-pre-install] removed bun.lock so EAS falls back to package-lock.json/npm (packageManager field alone is documented-unreliable in EAS Build -- github.com/expo/eas-cli/issues/2658 -- this hook only runs inside the ephemeral EAS build container, never touches the local repo)"
